name: Giant Ape (Torren summon reference)
languages: None; the summoning feature separately grants obedience to verbal commands.
bio: Original Monster Manual Giant Ape reference for Call of the Beast Lord. No ape begins play for free. Spend five maneuver points, maintain maneuver concentration and respect the 10-minute duration. One reference character can represent the current summoned token.

traits.name: Summon limits
traits.description: Acts immediately after Torren on the same initiative, takes verbal commands without an action, and disappears at 0 HP, when duration ends or when maneuver concentration ends.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Makes two fist attacks; this does not grant two rock attacks.
